concerns.text: The plan asserts that a lightweight discrete diffusion model with ≤ 100 M parameters can be trained on a 2‑core CPU runner within a 6‑hour wall‑clock limit (see “All steps respect the 6‑hour CPU wall‑clock limit … Model ≤ 100 M parameters”). Given the size of a diffusion model and the need for forward‑and‑backward passes over 10 epochs of GSM8K (≈ 5 000 training steps per run), this is likely to exceed the 6‑hour budget on the specified GitHub Actions runner. This creates a risk that many matrix jobs will hit the timeout flag, preventing the collection of the full set of seeds required for the paired statistical tests. Reduce the number of epochs, use a smaller model, or provide a concrete benchmark showing the per‑step runtime on the target hardware.
